correctness.rationale: The finite complex and all orientations are defined by a complete graph edge list. Every 20-vertex subset is enumerated; the matching covers 3054 pairs on 6113 faces; all 29610 Hasse arrows pass topological-sort acyclicity; the unique Morse 5-to-4 differential (1,0,-1) is primitive and pi_4 of a 4-sphere wedge is Z^3. Unique graph five-cycle gives automorphism upper bound 20; exactly 20 explicit dihedral maps exist. Lefschetz fixed-simplex signed traces yield rational character 1+epsilon. All exact assertions replayed from standalone verifier.

value.rationale: The first genuine Isaacs flower snark is a canonical extremal cubic graph. Its complete integral homotopy type and entire D10 homology character are motivated structural invariants, not an arbitrary finite parameter slice, and provide natural comparison data for investigations of higher flower snarks. The theorem distinguishes a globally invariant homology line from a rotation-odd line; no all-family theorem is claimed.
